dbqueries.dbquery: select tp.template_id, tp.template_code, tp.template_name, tp.template_subject_file, tp.template_content_file, tp.template_auto, tp.template_format, tp.template_private, tp.template_date_created, tp.user_id, ttt.template_type, tp.template_type_id, tp.template_is_default, tp.do_show_save_as_draft_option, tp.template_is_save_as_draft, CAST(group_concat(distinct tv.template_variable_type separator ',') AS CHAR ) as templateVariableIds, group_concat(tg.template_variable order by tg.template_variable separator ',') as templateVariables from tp_templates tp LEFT JOIN tp_template_types ttt ON (ttt.template_type_id=tp.template_type_id) LEFT JOIN tp_template_vars tv ON(tp.template_type_id = tv.template_type_id) LEFT JOIN tp_template_generic_vars tg ON (tv.template_variable_type=tg.template_variable_type) where tp.template_code=? group by tp.template_id

select tp.template_id, tp.template_code, tp.template_name, tp.template_subject_file, tp.template_content_file, tp.template_auto, tp.template_format, tp.template_private, tp.template_date_created, tp.user_id, ttt.template_type, tp.template_type_id, tp.template_is_default, tp.do_show_save_as_draft_option, tp.template_is_save_as_draft, CAST(group_concat(distinct tv.template_variable_type separator ',') AS CHAR ) as templateVariableIds, group_concat(tg.template_variable order by tg.template_variable separator ',') as templateVariables from tp_templates tp LEFT JOIN tp_template_types ttt ON (ttt.template_type_id=tp.template_type_id) LEFT JOIN tp_template_vars tv ON(tp.template_type_id = tv.template_type_id) LEFT JOIN tp_template_generic_vars tg ON (tv.template_variable_type=tg.template_variable_type) WHERE tp.template_type_id = ? AND tp.template_auto = ? GROUP BY tp.template_id ORDER BY tp.template_is_default desc, template_private LIMIT 0, 1
select tp.template_code, tp.template_name from tp_templates tp where tp.template_auto =? @@ group by tp.template_id

insert into `tp_templates` (`template_code`,`template_name`,`template_subject_file`, `template_content_file`,`template_auto`,`template_format`,`template_private`, `template_date_created`,`user_id`, template_type_id, template_is_save_as_draft, do_show_save_as_draft_option,is_repeat) values (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,now(),?, ?, ?, ?,?)
update tp_templates set template_name = ?, template_type_id = ?, template_is_save_as_draft = ?, is_repeat=? @@ where template_code = ?
update tp_templates set template_is_default=? where template_type_id=?
update tp_templates set template_is_default=? where template_code=?
select template_type_id from tp_templates where template_code = ?
